name: [COMBAT] Overworld
desc:
Overworld is an Open World RPG focused on leveling your skills and building your character.
Adventure with friends, complete quests, loot dungeons and slay legendary bosses for rare drops.

💀 Explore randomly generated dungeons.
⚒️ Craft powerful gear by gathering resources from across the world.
⚔️ Risk your gear in PVP or group up in PvE by creating a party.
🏹 Complete quests to obtain perks and expand your arsenal of tools, weapons and spells.
🎉 Level up and achieve mastery in 11 different skills!

⚙️ Controls can be changed by opening your inventory and clicking the settings menu.
🎮 Available only on PC and Console.

⛔️ Manipulation of game files will result in a ban. Please don't cheat.

 Inspired by RuneScape and The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
